overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the commission properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 over a threatened lawsuit, and the chair was not required to list litigation threat that arrived under three hours before the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the airport commission convened in executive session on April 12 without a proper statutory purpose, regarding a laundromat lease default.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Commission properly met in executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss its litigation strategy with respect to this matter.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the commission failed to list the April 12 executive session on its posted meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: The chair could not have anticipated the threat of litigation, and thus was not required to post notice of the executive session discussion related to that threat.
